description:
The SessionManager stores all session history as typed SessionEntry structs instead
of raw messages. Each entry has a base set of fields plus type-specific fields.

## Base fields (all entry types)

  id         — 8-character lowercase hex, unique within the session
  parent_id  — id of predecessor entry; nil for the root entry
  timestamp  — DateTime.utc_now() serialized as ISO 8601 string

## Entry types to define

Port from tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts lines 44-147.

1. MessageEntry         — wraps a User | Assistant | ToolResult message
   extra fields: message :: OctoPi.Agent.Message.t()

2. CompactionEntry      — stores a context-compaction summary
   extra fields: summary :: String.t(), first_kept_entry_id :: String.t(),
                 tokens_before :: non_neg_integer(), details :: term(),
                 from_hook? :: boolean()
   NOTE: first_kept_entry_id points to the oldest MessageEntry still inside
   the LLM context window after compaction.

3. BranchSummaryEntry   — created when navigating the session tree
   extra fields: from_id :: String.t(), summary :: String.t(),
                 details :: term(), from_hook? :: boolean()

4. CustomEntry          — extension state storage; NOT sent to the LLM
   extra fields: custom_type :: String.t(), data :: term()

5. CustomMessageEntry   — extension-injected messages that DO go to the LLM
   extra fields: custom_type :: String.t(),
                 content :: String.t() | [content_block()],
                 display :: boolean(), details :: term()
   NOTE: display: false = hidden from TUI; display: true = rendered in UI

6. ModelChangeEntry     — records model switches mid-session
   extra fields: provider :: atom(), model_id :: String.t()

7. LabelEntry           — user-defined bookmarks
   extra fields: entry_id :: String.t(), label :: String.t() | nil
   NOTE: label: nil removes the label from the referenced entry

8. SessionInfoEntry     — session-level metadata
   extra fields: display_name :: String.t()

## generate_id/1

Implement SessionEntry.generate_id/1 :: (MapSet.t(String.t())) -> String.t()

  :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(4) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)

Retry until the generated id is not in the existing-ids set.

## File layout

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session_entry.ex.
Use nested defmodule pattern matching event.ex (each type is a submodule, e.g.
SessionEntry.MessageEntry, SessionEntry.CompactionEntry, etc.).
Define OctoPi.Agent.SessionEntry.t() as the union type.

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/session_entry_test.exs.
  - generate_id/1 produces 8-char lowercase hex strings
  - generate_id/1 avoids IDs already in the set
  - each struct has id, parent_id, timestamp fields
  - each struct has its type-specific fields
title: Define SessionEntry types
